en: In the Name of ALLAH, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate
Praise belongs to ALLAH,
who has taken away the shadowy night by His power
and brought the sight-giving day through His mercy.
He has clothed me in its brightness and given me its favour.

ar: أَللَّهُمَّ فَكَما أَبْقَيْتَنِي لَهُ فَأَبْقِنِي لاَِمْثالِهِ،
en: O ALLAH, just as Thou hast spared me for this day, so also spare me for its likes,
bless the prophet MUHAMMAD and his Household,

ar: وَلا تَفْجَعْنِي فِيهِ وَفِي غَيْرِهِ مِنَ اللَّيالِي وَالاَيَّامِ بِارْتِكابِ الْمَحارِمِ، وَاكْتِسابِ الْمَاثِمِ،
en: torment me not in it and in other nights and days by allowing me to commit unlawful acts and to clothe myself in sins;

ar: وَارْزُقْنِي خَيْرَهُ، وَخَيْرَ ما فِيهِ، وَخَيْرَ ما بَعْدَهُ،
en: provide me with its good, the good of all within it, and the good of everything after it;

ar: وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَشَرَّ ما فِيهِ، وَشَرَّ ما بَعْدَهُ.
en: and turn away from me its evil, the evil of all within it, and the evil of everything after it!.
O ALLAH,
by the protective compact of Islam, I seek mediation with Thee!
by the inviolability of the Qur'an, I rely upon Thee!

ar: وَبِمُحَمَّد الْمُصْطَفى صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وآلِهِ أَسْتَشْفِعُ لَدَيْكَ،
en: By MUHAMMAD the chosen (ALLAH bless him and his Household), I seek intercession with Thee

ar: فَاعْرِفِ اللَّهُمَّ ذِمَّتِي الَّتِي رَجَوْتُ بِها قَضآءَ حاجَتِي،
en: So recognize my protective compact by which I hope my need will be granted,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!

ar: أَللَّهُمَّ اقْضِ لِي فِي الخَمِيسِ خَمْساً
en: O ALLAH, decree for me on Thursday five things
which none embraces but Thy generosity
and none supports but Thy favours:
health through which I may have the strength to obey Thee,
worship by which I may deserve Thy plentiful reward,

ar: وَسَعَةً فِي الْحالِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ الْحَلالِ،
en: plenty in my state through lawful provision,

ar: وَأَنْ تُؤْمِنَنِي فِي مَواقِفِ الْخَوْفِ بِأَمْنِكَ،
en: that Thou makest me secure in the places of fear through Thy security,

ar: وَتَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ طَوارِقِ الْهُمُومِ وَالْغُمُومِ فِي حِصْنِكَ،
en: and placest me in Thy fortress against the striking of worries and sorrows!
Bless MUHAMMAD and his Household,

ar: وَاجْعَل تَوَسُّلِي بِهِ شافِعَاً يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ نافِعاً،
en: and make my seeking his mediation as an intercessor give profit on the Day of Resurrection!
Surely Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful!
